about.heading: About ModuPort
about.description: ModuPort is a mechanics-based superelement solver for the structural analysis and layout screening of multi-storey framed modular structures. The interface uses millimetre–newton engineering units.
about.full_title: Full title: ModuPort: A Mechanics-Based Superelement Solver for Multi-Storey Framed Modular Structures with Arbitrary Layouts
about.scope_list:
- Linear-elastic static analysis
- Modal analysis
- Rectangular and supported irregular occupied-cell footprints
- Exhaustive horizontal/vertical module-layout enumeration
- Batch directional-stiffness screening
about.domain_text: One four-neighbour connected occupied-cell domain, exactly tiled by orthogonal 1×2 and 2×1 modules, with the same footprint and layout on every storey. ‘Arbitrary Layouts’ does not imply unrestricted geometry.
about.solver_text: Mechanics-based superelement solver with a numerically frozen validated core.
about.limitations_list:
- Linear analysis only
- One identical footprint and layout through all storeys
- Orthogonal 1×2 and 2×1 modules only
- No disconnected domains or storey-varying layouts
- No nonlinear, BIM, cloud, or external-FEA coupling
- Released under the MIT License
